title: Joler Aneno Lwenje Ng`eny
author: Traditional
content:
{title: Joler Aneno Lwenje Ng`eny}

{comment: Chorus}
Joler aneno lwenje ng`eny ,
Aneno lwenje ng`eny ekind joler
Aneno lwenje ng`eny ekind joler
Yesu kedo, wanalo
Jahera kedonwa, wanalo
Jahera kedonwa, wanalo

{comment: Verse 1}
Ruoth yesu manene okedo chon, 
Ma nene oloyo lweny, olamonwa
Ma nene oloyo lweny, olamonwa

{comment: Verse 2}
Kata piny lich masiche dongo,
To Yesu kedonwa wanalo
To Yesu kedonwa wanalo

{comment: Verse 3}
Thumbe tara gogendini duto,
Giwero Akonya Moriwo piny
Giwero Akonya Moriwo piny

{comment: Verse 4}
Wende Yesu mwawero sani,
Ginyiso herano mowarowa
Ginyiso herano mowarowa

{comment: Verse 5}
Jachien jakinda notemo Ayubu,
To Yesu Lwanda, notelone
To Yesu Lwanda, notelone

{comment: Verse 6}
Aweyo mwandu gi duong`na duto,
Kahero ngima moelore
Kahero ngima moelore

{comment: Verse 7}
Ageno Dala ma Yesu ong`iewo,
Nayud yueyo e paradis
Nayud yueyo e paradis

{comment: Verse 8}
Jogo duto mawinjo Duonde,
Nochokgi duto e paradis
Nochokgi duto e paradis

{comment: Verse 9}
Wanamor gi malaika duto,
Manie polo, maritowa
Manie polo, maritowa
